data.description: Benchmarks: indexing_throughput (docs/sec at 100, 1K, 10K), incremental_indexing (add_document_incremental vs full), batch_indexing (add_documents_batch), large_document (10KB, 100KB, 1MB docs). Use synthetic corpus generation for controllable sizes.

properties.retrospective:
Implemented 5 indexing benchmarks:
- IndexingThroughputBenchmark: docs/sec at 25/50/100/500/1000 doc scales
- IncrementalIndexingBenchmark: compares add_document_incremental() vs full recompute (340x speedup!)
- BatchIndexingBenchmark: compares batch vs sequential processing
- LargeDocumentBenchmark: tests 10KB/50KB/100KB/1MB documents
- ComputeAllBenchmark: phase-by-phase timing (tfidf, pagerank, bigram_connections, concepts, semantics)

All benchmarks pass in quick mode (~3.7s). Results saved to results/corpus_baseline_quick.json.

data.title: Implement indexing performance benchmarks
